notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l029: Кечээ retained yesterday rather than then; the narrative’s relative chronology is not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l016: Туу казанат is a tireless swift horse, explicit Yudakhin туу I https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?word=туу line82. Here an affectionate metaphor for Semetey; removed initial unsupported untried reading.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l012: Ар уруудан көйнөк means various dresses, Yudakhin under уруу; exact formula is quoted in the Manas encyclopedia кошок https://el-sozduk.kg/koshok/. No tribe of origin inferred. Singular collective noun rendered plural to express many kinds.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l013: The dress/neck image is preserved literally; the reason the garments fail to reach is not supplied. Plural agrees with the various dresses12.
notes.manas-2010:p1739:b001:l024: Көсөл/көзөл is outstanding brave man/leader, not көсөм wise elder: Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=к&alf2=кө&cur_page=29&dic_id=2&page=list_words. Removed unsupported wise one.
notes.manas-2010:p1739:b001:l025: Бейлөөсүз provisionally beyond surveying/reckoning, from бейле observe/consider. Not a moral epithet or a new rank. Exact nuance remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1736:b001:l041: Бээлесе=бейлесе consider/look over, following established Yudakhin бээле-/бейле- evidence https://el-sozduk.kg/бээ/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/бей/. Recast initial searched to preserve the verb; tabylbas unfindable renders no equal found among souls, referring to Syrgak next row.
notes.manas-2010:p1741:b001:l001: Бээлесе=бейлесе consider/look over, following Yudakhin бээле-/бейле- https://el-sozduk.kg/бээ/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/бей/. Phrase praises irreplaceable champions. No claim of a literal search expedition.
notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l001: Continuation of Manas demanding Almambet’s body on1721; no new speech beginning or living captive inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l003: Solomon’s inability to touch Beijing is the epic city epithet, not asserted as documented history. Same treatment for Alexander and Holy One formulae later.
notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l010: Near-identical champions/warriors preparation rows10–11 retained, not deduplicated.
notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l014: Олуя чалдын эр Бакай compressed saintly-elder epithet is rendered appositively; not an invented father named Oluya-Chal.
notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l015: Көк lynx-fur cap rendered blue without assigning a zoological species beyond lynx or correcting the conventional fur color.

notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l027: Качыр mule, distinct from качкын fugitive next row. The corpse is carried for enemy celebration, not described as alive.
notes.manas-2010:p1722:b001:l034: House-sized bronze idol explicitly retained; no particular deity identified from generic буркан.

notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l001: Дарысын literally remedy provisionally means effective means against the foe in this combat clause; no literal medicine dose supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l003: Алты сан provisionally six vast hosts; сан can designate a myriad or an innumerable multitude. Distinct from explicit алты түмөн60000 at1724:25.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l009: Golden forelock/tasseled belt describes the corpse’s habitual epithet, not a fresh donation or new person.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l011: Өңөрүү is holding/carrying in front on horseback; cheeks pressed together next row retained, no kiss added there.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l016: Devoured both is Manas’s culpability/grief metaphor for losing Almambet and Chubak, not literal cannibalism. Repeated throughout laments and retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l017: Эрикпей has boredom/loneliness/languishing senses; without longing is provisional in this bereavement context.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l019: Шейит martyr is the poem’s religious characterization of the fallen warrior; not a verified theological ruling.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l024: Сан кол vast army is metaphor for Chubak’s support, not a new numerical contingent.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l031: Караган pea-shrub image stands as a separate parallel verse; not excluded as a non-sequitur or heading.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l034: Каргылуу black mountain is the established impregnable/inaccessible mountain epithet; not an unknown place-name.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l038: Кашайып blind/stricken is grief’s image; no literal new diagnosis asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1723:b001:l040: Footless snake and mane/tail-less wild ass parallels continue across page1724; neither zoological image is rationalized away.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l003: Ойгут preserved as the named Oygut group; not normalized to a modern ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l004: Printed соолуи interpreted minimally as соолуп dried, required by drying-river image; raw remains unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l009: Табылга is meadowsweet/spiraea shrub, valley image retained without asserting an exact species.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l012: Жылгынды short form retained Zhylgyndy, not silently expanded to later Жылгындуу.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l020: Желбегей indicates a coat worn over shoulders without arms in sleeves; the image conveys readiness/contempt of danger, not nudity.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l023: Questioning whether his own life has found peace is bitter grief, not translator reassurance; kept as printed despite contradiction.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l025: Алты түмөн six ten-thousands=60000; distinct from unquantified-san host formulas.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l030: Taybuurul is the named mount after Akkula’s death. No horse replacement harmonized retrospectively.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l038: No tongue means no human speech; the horse’s physical tongue is not claimed absent.
notes.manas-2010:p1724:b001:l041: Кындырдай straight/thin/lean confirmed Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кын/769–772, including exact horse formula; not a plant simile.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l007: Same-day birth of Sarala and Almambet is explicit, not inferred from earlier shared-childhood images.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l017: Crunch/gulp sounds on17–18 retained, with both grass and water refusal.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l019: Кындырдай жараган is Yudakhin’s exact horse phrase become lean and ready for racing, https://el-sozduk.kg/кын/771. Retained lean and fit in mourning context; no emendation to starving/dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l023: Caught at a distance literal; no rope, trap or supernatural catching mechanism invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l026: Forty companions explicitly present after many have died; numerical inconsistency preserved, not silently changed to survivors.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l029: Silk is explicit жибек; суп qualified fine rope, not converted to camel-wool in contradiction to the line.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l031: Twelve winding/folding operations retained. The exact knot structure is not invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l035: Finding words in surprise and eyes in darkness is Bakai’s counsel/resourcefulness formula, with images retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l039: Шаңшуур gold ingot, verified primary Yudakhin quoted exact алтындан кылган шаңшуурду…канжыгага at https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=ш&alf2=ша&cur_page=17&dic_id=2&page=list_words; also2015dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/шаң/. Payment to buriers onnext1726:1 explains purpose; not a bell or tool.
notes.manas-2010:p1725:b001:l041: Source order maintained: Khan Almambet41 then Muslims bury42; draft reversed clauses corrected before freezing.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l003: Folding the body at waist explicitly retained; not treated as a ritual prescription or silently omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l007: Кан ыйлап may be khan(s) weeping in the status list or weeping blood idiom. Provisional parallel honored men/khans reading retained; ambiguity recorded rather than definitive anatomical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l019: As though understanding speech is explicit comparison for Sarala, not a translator’s claim of ordinary animal language.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l025: Safe and sound describes delivery/presentation of the body, not resurrection.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l026: Ыслам rendered the Muslim people/community, the intended recipients; no specific town or Mecca added where not named.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l032: Азирет Holy One formula conventionally relates to holy Ali; kept less specific where this verse does not name him, contrasted explicit1735:12.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l036: Back to me/let my eyes see is printed although the horse is sent ahead to burial; apparent tension retained, not changed to distant Meccans.
notes.manas-2010:p1726:b001:l039: Жыттап literally smelling affectionately/nuzzling, rendered kiss. The tactile/scent form remains qualified in note, not a mouth kiss inferred in other lines.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l012: Бүлүк turmoil retained, not silently corrected to мүлк wealth. It contrasts destructive result with the following spoils list.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l013: Кара байыр is the Karabayyr horse type/designation; not an ordinary black horse color.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l014: Sieve-like lungs/copper forelegs are heroic endurance epithets, not literal respiratory injury or metal prostheses.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l020: Women and girls are explicitly taken as spoils; preserved as coercive taking, not softened to willing brides.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l022: Бил elephant, established Yudakhin usage https://el-sozduk.kg/бил/. Red tails and gold loading retained despite unusual zoological color.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l024: Dark-eyed thousand understood women in the captive list; no age supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l028: 7000/700/6000/600 each retained in order; no numerical harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l039: Оймоктуу thimble-bearing skilled needlewomen, not a woman named Oymoktu.
notes.manas-2010:p1727:b001:l040: Буттап is by pood weight units; no modern kilogram conversion without fixed contextual standard.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l003: All champions slaughtered is followed by survivors4 and named living Manas/Bakai; narrator’s totalizing language retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l009: Millet clean as stone and wives praised as girls are the Kazakh portrayal in the poem; literal images retained without asserting a modern ethnic trait.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l016: Oblique/flank strike retained; subject the lost khan collective’s disaster, no invented ambush location.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l019: Without sheaths explicit кынсыз, not corrected to sheathed for plausibility.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l024: Тобунун колу provisionally assembled troops, coming apart after their leader’s death; not detached literal human hands.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l026: Printed сары огой lacks н; minimally interpreted Sary Nogoy as confirmed same-page40сары ногой. Raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l031: Өлгөндө көргөн is late-life/long-awaited child idiom, not a child born after Kökötöy’s literal death.
notes.manas-2010:p1728:b001:l042: Ар=camel is positive Yudakhin arII; gold loading clarified not unsupported emendation нар.
notes.manas-2010:p1729:b001:l012: Battle-axe wound at back/neck is printed; not harmonized to earlier spear wound at waist.
notes.manas-2010:p1729:b001:l019: Карагай каршы, тал жумшак antithesis provisionally pine resistant/hard, willow soft, leading to juniper choice. No timber engineering conclusion asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1729:b001:l020: Табыт bier, here used for the wounded living Manas, not a declaration he has died. Juniper material explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p1729:b001:l021: Суп fine-cloth mattress; exact fiber unspecified, not ordinary cotton asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1729:b001:l028: 7000red camels and braiding their tails retained. No assumption of horse from tail-braiding custom.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l001: Six-day respite refers backward; no new bargain invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l015: Асый horse maturity age (first асый at five), referring to Taybuurul next row, not Manas’s age.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l017: Желмаян swift camel; not invented personal name Zhelmay an or a horse. Ок ammunition remains explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l021: Printed алба lacks й; interpreted minimally as албай without sleep, parallel previous албай. Raw unchanged; not an unsolicited imperative to the reader.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l027: Кан болуп here as khan, with Manas standing28; not blood as in battle description elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l029: Азан is call to prayer. The striking of his head30 is printed; not harmonized with earlier weapon/target.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l031: The letter is explicitly intended to cushion shock; its victorious claims later are preserved as the message, not certified narrator facts.
notes.manas-2010:p1730:b001:l037: Palm-sized letter literal; not exact paper dimensions.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l005: Kongurbay tied to a leading rein is the letter’s claim, not a correction to the earlier escape.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l011: Almambet raised as khan is preserved in the reassuring letter although reader knows he is dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l012: Printed mountain of mined gold and tea retained; no replacement with invented tea-tax treasury. Exact coordination is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l016: Not die means avoiding fatal shock in the letter’s context; no assurance that a feast medically prevents death.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l017: 1000mares/1000camels retained; black/white-blazed contrast for mares, dark camels.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l021: 90-year-old elders and12-year-old boys explicitly included. No age censorship or omitted child reference.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l026: Yrchy Uul is Yraman’s singer-son, established name/title, not an unnamed new narrator.

notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l031: Beside him27 shifts to beside me31 in the printed letter; pronouns preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l036: Кур barren/nonlactating here provisionally wholly barren gray mares; not hungry merely from modern adjective associations.
notes.manas-2010:p1731:b001:l039: Sixty golden tents to fold is printed бүксүн, not silently pitched or collapsed into the two royal yurts next row.
notes.manas-2010:p1732:b001:l006: Кыргак is the head-band; black mourning preparation among festive dress is not harmonized to a single costume color.
notes.manas-2010:p1732:b001:l024: Долу fierce woman is Kanykey’s conventional forceful epithet; not a medical diagnosis or translator insult.
notes.manas-2010:p1732:b001:l032: Fine-cloth dress worn next to skin; no fabric fiber asserted. This garment alone does not establish medical or supernatural power.
notes.manas-2010:p1732:b001:l036: Kanykey knows the six-month anguish despite the reassuring letter, as the narrator states; no invented messenger exposed it.
notes.manas-2010:p1732:b001:l041: Late-life child idiom, with explicit six-month age next row retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l008: Rib bones coming apart is grief hyperbole, not clinically verified fracture.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l011: Олоң girth comparison for thick hair retained, different from preceding чылбыр rein image.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l025: Кабак high bank/slope, not eyelid here because she directs her mount toward it.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l027: Оймокбооч салуу painful twisting pinch, exact child-cry formula verified primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/оймок/. No thimble or implement invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l028: Striking/pinching the baby to make him cry is explicit narrative action; not omitted, approved, or expanded into parenting advice.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l029: Same оймокбооч exact painful pinch, source https://el-sozduk.kg/оймок/. Child cries remain four repetitions30.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l034: Manas rises from the bier while alive; not a literal resurrection.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l036: Bakai is good fortune ahead and vast army, the familiar support formula; no actual extra army appears.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l040: Malicious slave-woman is Manas’s harsh speech about Kanykey; retained despite his recognizing her intent next lines.
notes.manas-2010:p1733:b001:l041: Кабактан күйүп high-bank/grief expression is provisional; not burned skin, following her place at25.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l002: Manas infers the pinch was intended to rouse him, indicated бейм. Not a new claim that he directly saw it.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l003: Four onomatopoeic child cries retained, translated Ee rather than opaque кыргыз sound or omitted repetition.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l008: Чолпон morning star is affectionate child imagery beside falcon/goshawk, not a new person called Cholpon.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l019: Кан ичме blood-drinker/bloodthirst is the heroic battle rage; no medical syndrome assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l022: Bozkise is the named sacred gray pouch-belt; established object retained alongside translated type.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l029: Арбуудан explicit mount designation preserved as Arbuudan, not silently equated to Taybuurul. Аркалуу powerful/protective support remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l030: Сыртынан курчанып girding outside provisionally over armor just donned; exact belt/object omitted in source and not named anew.
notes.manas-2010:p1734:b001:l037: Урдуу radiant per Yudakhin нурдуу equivalence https://el-sozduk.kg/урдуу/; not Urdu.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l004: Адам is possibly narrator’s vocative rather than object; English she faced the man is a qualified syntactic reading, not a separate character introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l010: Жылма кер sleek bay is a horse epithet, not a verified proper name. Death metaphor passed retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l012: Holy Ali explicitly named here, unlike shorter Азирет formula elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l018: Керээз counsel/solemn charge from living Kanykey, not her deathbed testament.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l034: Шай holy protectors/patrons, established phrase; no individual named Shay invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l037: Fatal gaze supernatural claim is the source’s explanation for withholding the child. Repetition41 retained, no modern biological assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1735:b001:l039: Сүйүү love/caress in child-handling context; caress preserves physical risk narrative rather than implying he feels no affection despite pleading.
notes.manas-2010:p1736:b001:l011: Female subject inferred Kanykey handling the offered whip and touching the child; exact token-passing procedure not expanded.

notes.manas-2010:p1736:b001:l029: He braces the axe against his side as support in mourning; not a new axe wound or self-injury event.

notes.manas-2010:p1737:b001:l003: Жанды тындырдым literally stilled life is bitter lament while Manas lives. No claim he has died or wishes the user to die.
notes.manas-2010:p1737:b001:l017: Турбадым negative form in a rhetorical question about besieging; not silently rewritten as plain positive.
notes.manas-2010:p1737:b001:l018: Шибээ ethnic group and ылама lamas provisionally collective; no assumed new two named individuals.
notes.manas-2010:p1737:b001:l023: Бейпай distress interpreted from repeated usage, exact nuance remains provisional; no changed source spelling.

notes.manas-2010:p1737:b001:l033: Standalone pied-headed steed formula retained as verse despite loose connection to crowd list.
notes.manas-2010:p1737:b001:l037: Liquor-drunk mourners explicitly included; no claim drinking is recommended for grief.

notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l004: Bad name awaits me is provisional тозуп алар жаман ат in widow’s lament, rather than a bad horse herd-master. Exact relation remains uncertain; no new husband or shame custom invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l007: Shared tiny childhood language is her lament formula; not biological twinship or a verified infant marriage event.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l009: She asks to be carried with the dead beloved. The lament is preserved without converting poetic speech into an actual burial of a living widow.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l016: Thirty rivers/thirty mountains and rushing water/narrow pass metaphor retained in full; no logical correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l023: Burulcha is explicitly Esenkan’s daughter; this row does not name her husband and English does not supply one.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l028: Torn bloody faces, loose hair and streaming tears explicitly retained mourning imagery; no additional method of injury supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l030: Ур radiant cheek parallels урдуу; no proper name Ur.
notes.manas-2010:p1738:b001:l041: No son left behind is the women’s present lament; not harmonized with earlier unborn-child references or later heirs.
notes.manas-2010:p1739:b001:l001: 9000explicit horses differs from prior тогуз сан; retained without changing either to agree.

notes.manas-2010:p1740:b001:l007: Кындай fitting/sheathing steel, distinct from кынсыз unsheathed swords1728:19.

notes.manas-2010:p1741:b001:l003: Standalone Капырай translated Good heavens and counted as a verse, not editorial interjection.
